capabilities.description: Two-way watch history, watchlist, favorites, and movie and series ratings, resume progress import, and live scrobbling for an MDBList account.

connection_settings.label: Sync favorites
connection_settings.description: Keep this profile's favorite movies and series in a private MDBList list named Silo Favorites. The plugin creates the list in your MDBList account the first time it sends a favorite. Turn this on for every Silo server that should share favorites.

presentation.summary: Sync Silo watch history, watchlists, favorites, and ratings with MDBList.
presentation.description_markdown: Imports and exports movie and episode watch history, imports resume progress, syncs the MDBList watchlist in its own order, can keep movie and series favorites in a private MDBList list named Silo Favorites when Sync favorites is turned on, syncs movie and series ratings in both directions, and forwards live playback start, pause, and stop events.
presentation.setup_markdown:
Each Silo profile connects with its own MDBList API key, created on the API page of your [MDBList preferences](https://mdblist.com/preferences/#api). The plugin needs no server-wide settings.

MDBList's free tier allows 1,000 requests a day. The plugin paces requests to about one a second per key, and when MDBList reports the limit, Silo waits before the next sync.
